title: Xdrip only using one calibration for calibration line
symptom: After having issues with calibrations not being accepted and restarting calibration, the line of best fit seems to be broken, and it appears to only be using the latest calibration for the line of best fit.
fix: Uninstalled the app last night and reinstalled and that worked.
evidence_quote: Uninstalled the app last night and reinstalled and that worked
